notes.title: Tutorial Changes
notes.content:
Made significant changes to the tutorial to help new players that are unfamiliar with Ghost investigation tools and new to the genre.

Also, other updates pertaining to improving interactions and squashing bugs.

notes.title: Interactions and Tutorials
notes.content:
Improved interaction boxes to make useability easier
Corrected some bugs with the tutorial that created timing issues.

notes.title: Ghost Spawning
notes.content: - Corrected an issue where the Red Herring was not spawning.

notes.title: Quick Fixes
notes.content:
- Improved interaction boxes
- Adjusted ghosts' behaviors
- Fixed Typos

notes.title: Beta testing is live!
notes.content:
The Beta build will focus on the investigation game play loop.

Only two floors of the mansion are available to investigate.

No story or lore related content is in the beta.

notes.title: Bug smashing
notes.content: I fixed a bug related to rooms not loading.  It should be better now...
